dek: Alibaba Cloud's CUBE 5.0 modular design compresses AI data-center delivery to 100 days and cuts unit cost by 10 percent. The Ulanqab deployment is the canonical example, with the city now running 17.2 million P of compute and hosting 90 percent intelligent computing share.
